observation_reviews.rationale: Point (b). The wrapper adds the alternative \s(One|...|Ten)\s+(Delayed|Revolving|Term)\b to staging.distinct_member_suffix_re. The key can only split dedup partitions, never merge them. It matches 28 member strings across the cached filings (Soteria, Pave America, Houseworks, Smilist, MoboTrex, Refresh, Quick Roofing, NE Ortho). Effect measured on rffcc -> rffcd: 2,770 common rows with no change to value, name, instrument or position_id; one row added (NE Ortho C_9fc950b8, FV 0, cost -16,554, as printed); excluded_affiliation_dedup counts identical in every other quarter (the rest are subtotal contexts and one 2023-06-30 money-market twin). Pavement Partners 2024-03-31 is a true twin: one printed line, 'Pavement Partners Interco, LLC (f)(h) Revolving Credit Facility - - 2/7/2028 - ( 89,735 )', whose maturity is tagged on C_2aea6736 (published) and whose cost on C_f1a2fa7d (deduped). Point (c), entity relabel: all 25 NE Ortho Management Services rows (2024-12-31 to 2026-03-31) carry one entity_id 3d3c2284 (was 89bb027f on 24), canonical name unchanged, the legacy alias ENT-00000113 now maps to 3d3c2284, and no other entity moved. Mechanism: durable_identity mints identity_id = uuid5('initial-observation:' || min(row_id)), and the new row's ROW-0117b78a... is the group's smallest row_id. The relabel is consistent, but it shows entity ids are not stable when a row is added in an unpinned sandbox build. The suggested detector is concrete.
